stem: Which of these is an example of **system software**?

options.content: A device driver for a printer
options.rationale: Correct: a driver lets the operating system control a device, so it looks after the computer.

options.content: A spreadsheet used to work out a budget
options.rationale: A spreadsheet does a task for the user, so it is application software.

options.content: A word processor used to type a letter
options.rationale: Typing a letter is the user's task: application software.

options.content: A media player used to watch a film
options.rationale: Playing media is a user task: application software.

explanation: System software (operating system, utilities, drivers, translators) runs and manages the computer. The other three carry out tasks for the user.

stem: What is the main purpose of **application software**?

options.content: To carry out a task that the user wants to do
options.rationale: Correct: applications provide the services the user needs.

options.content: To manage the hardware and memory of the computer
options.rationale: That is the job of the operating system, which is system software.

options.content: To translate program code into machine code
options.rationale: That is done by translators, which are system software.

options.content: To keep the computer free of viruses and errors
options.rationale: Anti-virus and other maintenance tools are utilities (system software).

explanation: Application software provides the services the user requires, such as writing, calculating, drawing or browsing.

stem: A computer's magnetic hard disk takes a long time to open files because each file is split into parts stored all over the disk. Which utility should be used?

options.content: Disk clean-up
options.rationale: Clean-up deletes unwanted files to free space; it does not reorganise the parts of files.

options.content: Disk defragmenter
options.rationale: Correct: it moves the parts of each file so they are stored together, so files are read faster.

options.content: Compression software
options.rationale: Compression makes files smaller but does not put scattered parts back together.

options.content: Backup software
options.rationale: Backup copies files elsewhere; the files on the disk stay scattered.

explanation: Fragmented files slow down a magnetic disk because the read-write heads must move to many places. Defragmenting stores each file in one continuous area.

stem: Which utility removes temporary files and empties the recycle bin to free storage space?

options.content: Disk defragmenter
options.rationale: A defragmenter rearranges files; it does not delete them.

options.content: File manager
options.rationale: A file manager lets the user delete files one by one, but does not search for temporary files automatically.

options.content: Disk clean-up
options.rationale: Correct: it finds and removes files that are no longer needed.

options.content: Device driver
options.rationale: A driver controls a hardware device; it is not a maintenance tool.

explanation: Disk clean-up searches for unnecessary files (temporary files, old downloads, recycle bin contents) and deletes them to free space.

stem: Chipo wants to send 40 photographs by email, but together they are larger than the attachment limit. Which utility would help most?

options.content: Disk defragmenter
options.rationale: Defragmenting changes where files are stored on the disk, not their size.

options.content: Anti-virus software
options.rationale: Scanning for viruses does not change the size of the files.

options.content: Backup software
options.rationale: A backup makes a copy of the same size somewhere else.

options.content: Compression software
options.rationale: Correct: compressing the photos into an archive reduces the total size.

explanation: Compression reduces file size so the files need less space and transfer faster.

stem: How is a **compiler** classified, and why?

options.content: Application software, because a programmer opens it to do a task
options.rationale: Being opened by a person does not make it an application; its job is translation for the processor.

options.content: A utility, because it checks a programmer's source code for errors and reports them
options.rationale: Error reporting is part of translation; a compiler is classed as a translator, not a maintenance utility.

options.content: System software, because it translates code into machine code for the computer
options.rationale: Correct: translators are system software even though programmers start them deliberately.

options.content: Hardware, because it is part of the processor
options.rationale: A compiler is a program, so it is software.

explanation: Compilers, interpreters and assemblers are translators, a type of system software.
hints: Ask whether the program's job is the user's task or the computer's needs.

stem: Why should a solid-state drive (SSD) **not** be defragmented?

options.content: Its files are always stored in one continuous area of the drive, so they can never become fragmented
options.rationale: Files can be fragmented on an SSD too; it simply does not matter for speed.

options.content: Defragmenting would delete all the files on it
options.rationale: Defragmenting moves files; it does not delete them.

options.content: An SSD is volatile, so the files it holds are lost when it is switched off
options.rationale: An SSD is non-volatile secondary storage.

options.content: It has no moving read-write heads, so fragments do not slow it, and extra writes shorten its life
options.rationale: Correct: access time is the same wherever data is stored, and flash memory wears with each write.

explanation: Defragmenting helps magnetic disks because heads move less. An SSD has no heads, and the many extra writes would wear out its flash memory.
hints: Think about how a solid-state drive stores data: are there any moving parts?

stem: Why must anti-virus software be updated regularly?

options.content: The software deletes itself automatically after a month unless it is updated
options.rationale: Anti-virus software is not deleted by itself.

options.content: New viruses appear, and the software needs their signatures to recognise them
options.rationale: Correct: the database of known threats must be kept current.

options.content: Updating defragments the hard disk at the same time
options.rationale: Updating anti-virus software does not defragment the disk.

options.content: Old versions slow down the internet connection for every other user
options.rationale: The reason for updating is detection of new threats, not internet speed.

explanation: Anti-virus software compares files with signatures of known malware; without updates it cannot recognise new malware.

stem: Running a disk defragmenter frees up storage space on a hard disk.
explanation: False. A defragmenter rearranges the parts of files so they are stored together, which speeds up access. It does not delete anything, so the space used stays the same.

stem: The operating system is an example of system software.
explanation: True. The operating system is the main system software: it manages the hardware and provides a platform for applications.

stem: Match each utility to what it does.

right.content: Lets the user copy, move, rename and organise files in folders
Stores the parts of each file next to each other
Scans files and quarantines or deletes malware
Copies files to another device so they can be restored

explanation: Each utility performs one housekeeping task: protect, copy, free space, organise or reorganise.

stem: Classify each program as system software or application software.

left.content: Payroll program used to calculate wages

explanation: Payroll and presentation software do the user's tasks (application). The operating system, drivers and translators look after the computer (system).

payload.template: Software that provides the services the computer needs is called {{blank:a}} software. A {{blank:b}} is a program that lets the operating system communicate with a printer. A {{blank:c}} program makes a second copy of files on another device.

explanation: System software serves the computer; drivers control devices; backup utilities keep a second copy.

stem: Name the type of utility that compares files with a database of known malware signatures.
explanation: Anti-virus (anti-malware) software scans files and compares them with known signatures.

stem: Describe the difference between system software and application software. [2]

points.description: System software provides the services the computer needs / runs and manages the hardware (e.g. operating system, utility)
Application software provides the services the user needs / carries out a user task (e.g. word processor, spreadsheet)

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: System software, such as the operating system, provides the services the computer needs to run and manage its hardware. Application software, such as a spreadsheet, provides the services the user needs to carry out a task.

explanation: Both halves are needed: who the software serves, with an example of each.
hints: Say who each type of software serves, then give an example of each.

stem: Explain why a school office should use backup software every day. [2]

points.description: Backup software copies the files to another device / location (e.g. external drive, cloud)
If the original files are lost, deleted, corrupted or infected, they can be restored from the copy

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: The backup utility copies the office files to a separate device each day, so if the originals are deleted, corrupted or lost to malware or a disk failure, they can be restored with little loss.

explanation: A backup is a second copy kept elsewhere; its value is that data can be restored.
hints: Describe what the utility does, then the benefit.

stem: Farai's laptop has a magnetic hard disk. It is running slowly, its disk is almost full, and some files have been damaged by a virus.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Which type of software is the anti-virus program that Farai should run?

options.content: Application software
options.rationale: It looks after the computer, not a user task.

options.content: System software (a utility)
options.rationale: Correct.

options.content: A device driver
options.rationale: Drivers control hardware devices.

options.content: A translator
options.rationale: Translators convert program code.

parts.explanation: Anti-virus is a utility, part of system software.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Describe how the anti-virus software deals with the virus.

points.description: Scans files and compares them with a database of known virus signatures / looks for suspicious behaviour
Quarantines or deletes the infected files (and alerts the user)

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: It scans every file, comparing it with signatures of known viruses, then quarantines or deletes any infected file and warns Farai.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Which utility should Farai use to free storage space?

options.content: Disk defragmenter
options.rationale: This rearranges files but frees no space.

options.content: Anti-virus
options.rationale: This removes malware, not temporary files.

options.content: File manager
options.rationale: It can delete files but does not find temporary files for him.

options.content: Disk clean-up
options.rationale: Correct.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Explain how defragmenting the disk could make the laptop faster.

points.description: The parts of each file are moved so they are stored next to each other (and free space is grouped)
The read-write heads move less, so files are read / opened faster

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: The defragmenter moves the scattered parts of each file into one continuous area, so the read-write heads move less and files open faster.

explanation: Anti-virus (utility) removes the virus; clean-up frees space; defragmenting speeds up a magnetic disk.
hints: Match each symptom to the utility that fixes it.
Remember that defragmenting does not help a solid-state drive.

stem: The computer laboratory at Mutare Hills Secondary School (fictional) is being set up for Form 1 learners.

parts.label: (a)
parts.explanation: Spreadsheet and browser: application; OS and driver: system.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Name **two** kinds of system software other than the operating system and utilities.

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: Device drivers and translators such as compilers.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: The technician wants to **optimise** the computers before term starts. Describe **two** utilities she could use and what each does.

points.description: Names a suitable utility (e.g. defragmenter, disk clean-up, anti-virus)
Correctly describes what the second named utility does (e.g. clean-up deletes temporary files to free space)

answerSpec.markingNotes: Example answer: A disk defragmenter puts the parts of each file together so files load faster; disk clean-up deletes temporary files to free space.

explanation: Spreadsheets and browsers are applications; operating systems, drivers, translators and utilities are system software.
hints: Two kinds of system software other than utilities are drivers and translators.
Optimising a system means making it run better, not adding new tasks.
